jobs_results.description:
Oferta laboral | Compensation Operations Analyst

¿Tienes experiencia en compensación, operaciones de Recursos Humanos y análisis de datos y buscas una oportunidad en un entorno regional e internacional?


¿Qué buscamos?
- Profesional en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería de Sistemas o carreras afines.
- 1 a 3 años de experiencia laboral, idealmente con mínimo 1 año en compensación, HR Operations, Business Operations o posiciones con un fuerte componente de análisis de datos.
- Inglés avanzado/fluido, indispensable para brindar soporte a Estados Unidos y Canadá.
- Manejo de Excel intermedio-avanzado.


Será un plus tener conocimiento de Workday, Salesforce, Payfactors, sistemas HRIS o herramientas de reporting.


?? ¿Cuáles serán tus principales retos?
- Brindar soporte operativo en procesos de compensación para la región de las Américas.
- Apoyar la gestión y revisión de ofertas laborales y casos relacionados con compensación.
- Realizar seguimiento de casos, indicadores, SLA y tiempos de respuesta.
- Apoyar actividades relacionadas con ciclos anuales de compensación, encuestas y estructuras salariales.
- Analizar información y elaborar reportes para facilitar la toma de decisiones.
- Trabajar de manera colaborativa con diferentes áreas y stakeholders.


Condiciones de la oferta

- Ubicación: Bogotá, sector Calle 26.
 - Modalidad: Híbrida, 3 días en oficina y 2 días desde casa. 
 - Horario: Lunes a viernes, de 8:00 a. m. a 5:00 p. m.
 - Salario: $4.700.000 COP mensuales.
 - Contrato: Obra ó labor por 5 meses


?? ¿Te interesa?

Si cuentas con experiencia en Compensación, HR Operations o análisis de datos, tienes un excelente manejo de Excel y puedes comunicarte fluidamente en inglés, ¡queremos conocerte!

Postúlate y haz parte de este nuevo reto profesional.

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst Team Lead
jobs_results.description:
Join Blossom!


We are a U.S.-based company with over 20 years of experience dedicated to enhancing the satisfaction of credit unions and their members. We are committed to developing simpler and more innovative financial services that assist credit unions in serving their current members and attracting new ones. We are building the next-generation technology layer for credit unions.


www.blossom.net


We're looking for a strategic and hands-on Lead of Data with 5+ years of relevant experience, including at least 2 years leading teams, who thrives in fast-paced environments and is comfortable working across the full AWS data stack. The ideal candidate delivers scalable, reliable data architecture and reporting solutions, maintains strong standards for data quality and governance, and communicates clearly across technical and executive teams to support faster, more confident data-driven decision-making.


Role Purpose
Define and execute the organization's data strategy, leading a multidisciplinary team (Data Engineers, Data Analysts, BI Developers, and a Data Scientist/ML Engineer) to build scalable AWS-based solutions that drive data-informed decision-making.
Leadership Responsibilities

Supervise and manage the data team: performance reviews, feedback, career development plans.
Lead recruitment, onboarding, and mentoring of new team members.
Allocate resources and assign tasks for efficient workload distribution.
Foster a collaborative environment and continuous learning culture.
Ensure compliance with data governance and quality standards.

Technical Responsibilities

Design and lead the AWS data architecture (ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehouses in PostgreSQL/MySQL, S3 storage).
Translate business needs into analytics and reporting solutions.
Establish data quality, governance, and security standards.
Define and prioritize the data roadmap aligned with company strategy.
Oversee development of dashboards, reports, and predictive models (Python, BI tools, ML).
Optimize performance of relational databases and AWS data clusters.
Evaluate new technologies to continuously improve the data stack.

Key Competencies

Effective communication with both technical and executive audiences.
Analytical thinking and problem-solving.
Business insight and results orientation.
Collaborative leadership and talent development.
Innovation mindset and continuous improvement.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or related field.
5+ years in data roles, including at least 2 years leading teams.
Proven experience designing data architectures on AWS (Redshift, S3, Glue, Lambda, ECS/EKS).
Python proficiency for pipeline development and analysis.
Advanced experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL).
Familiarity with BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent).
Understanding of ML frameworks and model deployment.
Data modeling, warehousing, and query optimization skills.
Experience designing data APIs and microservices.
Advanced technical English; solid grasp of CI/CD and agile methodologies.

Perks

100% Remote Work – Work from anywhere during the contract period.
Multicultural Environment – Collaborate with global teams.
Learning & Exposure – Gain hands-on experience in a fintech/digital banking environment.
Impactful Work – Contribute to data solutions that drive strategic decisions.

Apply Now!

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst (Client Operations)
jobs_results.description:
Company description

Publicis Global Delivery (PGD); Publicis Groupe’s industry leading globally connected capability platform. Where talent, technology & operations combine to delivery amazing solutions for our clients. Expertise across Media, Data, Technology, Commerce & Production in all regions of the world. 

PGD is comprised of the best talent, and ways-of-working, which enables global scale, innovation and transformation, each day.

Culture, growth and wellbeing underline all aspects of Publicis Global Delivery.

#WeArePGD

 
Overview

We are looking for a Data Analyst (Client Operations) to join our team in Colombia.

This role focuses on data analysis, insight generation, automation, and the maintenance of internal reporting tools. The position plays a key role in improving operational efficiency, data accuracy, and decision‑making across the organization.

A strong background in data analysis is required, with hands‑on experience in Azure, Python, and Power BI.

This position works closely with Finance Business Excellence and Delivery teams and supports process optimization through data‑driven insights.

 
Responsibilities

Analyze operational and business data to identify trends, patterns, and insights that support decision‑making.
Review, maintain, and enhance reporting solutions (Power BI dashboards and internal reports).
Ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability of data across sources.
Develop and maintain automation flows to streamline processes and reduce manual tasks.
Identify data or process issues and propose corrective or improvement actions.
Translate business needs into effective technical solutions.
Support the maintenance and enhancement of internal tools and services.

 
Qualifications

Mandatory Requirements

1–3 years of experience in data analysis or reporting
Strong hands-on experience with Azure or similar platforms for large-scale data management and processing.
Hands‑on experience with Python.
Solid experience building and maintaining dashboards in Power BI.
High proficiency in Excel.
Strong analytical thinking and problem‑solving skills.
Experience validating and ensuring data quality.
English level B2/B2+ (written and spoken).

 

⭐ Nice to Have

Experience with Power Query / DAX.
Experience creating flows in Power Automate.
Experience with Power Apps.
Familiarity with the Microsoft 365 ecosystem.
Experience supporting internal tools or process improvement initiatives.
Experience with ticketing systems (JIRA, Asana, etc.).

 

📣 Soft Skills

Solution‑oriented mindset.
Attention to detail (data validation, quality checks, and accuracy).
Strong logical and analytical thinking.
High attention to detail in data validation and testing.
Ability to translate business requirements into technical outputs.
Time‑management and delivery focus.
Adaptability in fast‑changing environments.

*The vacancy is offered as a hybrid role
